No finite computation is used to infer the infinite asymptotics.

value.rationale: Half-integer flux is a distinguished spectral regime in the source: the momentum-band probability collapses to zero while flat bands appear. The exact surviving scale is therefore a natural spectral invariant. The logarithmic momentum law and square-root energy law quantify persistence invisible to the leading probability and distinguish two physically natural parametrizations of the same non-flat bands.
